MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), characterized by high expression of markers like CD68, CD14, and Mac2/Galectin-3. The presence of CD169 and CD1a suggests a possible M2-like polarization, consistent with their role in tumor promotion and immunosuppression. The low expression of CD8, CD20, and HLA-DR is suggestive of a non-antigen-presenting or regulatory macrophage phenotype. The high DAPI intensity indicates a significant proportion of these cells are likely to be dying or undergoing apoptosis. The high expression of CD40 and CD1c may indicate interaction with other cells in the tumor microenvironment. The overall profile is consistent with a macrophage-enriched population within the tumor microenvironment, potentially contributing to tumor progression and immune evasion.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: Macrophage-enriched cluster with high expression of HLA-DR, Podoplanin, and SMA, and low expression of mast cell tryptase, CD169, GP100, CD1a, PNAd, and CD66. This cluster is likely to be composed of macrophages, possibly with an activated phenotype.

MedGemma.title: Mast Cell-Like Phenotype
MedGemma.description: This cluster exhibits high expression of mast cell markers (mast cell tryptase, CD103, CD66) and GP100, suggesting a mast cell-like or related phenotype. Low expression of CD4, CD20, and CD45RO is consistent with a non-lymphoid cell type. The presence of CD1a and CD169 further supports a mast cell-like identity. The overall profile is suggestive of a cell type involved in inflammation and tissue remodeling, potentially residing in the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Mast cell-like
BioMistral.description: A cluster of cells with high expression of mast cell tryptase, GP100, PNAd, Granzyme B, CD8, and CD14, and low expression of TCF-1, CD66, CD45RO, PD-1, Axl, CD20, and CD11c. The cluster is characterized by a high average intensity per channel, including DAPI, CD8, CD20, HLA-DR, Podoplanin, SMA, CD4, Ki67, AQP1, ICOS, Mac2/Galectin-3, CD31, CD68, b-Catenin1, CD3e, CD103, Pan-Cytokeratin, FOXP3, CD45RO, SOX10, TCF-1, CD14, IL-33, PD-1, Granzyme B, S100b, PD-L1, CD57, CSPG4, Collagen IV, IFNG, IDO1, CD21, CD11c, TOX, CD40, CD1c, NGFR, Clec9a, Axl, mast cell tryptase, CD169, GP100, CD1a, PNAd, and CD66. The cluster is likely to be a mixture of mast cells and other immune cells, such as monocytes/macrophages and dendritic cells.

MedGemma.title: Cytotoxic T Cell Infiltrate
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a cytotoxic T cell infiltrate, characterized by high expression of CD8, Granzyme B, and HLA-DR. The low expression of markers like GP100, mast cell tryptase, and b-Catenin1 is consistent with the cytotoxic function of these cells. The presence of CD57 and PD-1 suggests potential exhaustion, but further analysis is needed to confirm. The overall profile is suggestive of an anti-tumor immune response.

BioMistral.title: Tumour-associated macrophages
BioMistral.description: A cluster of cells with high expression of CD14, CD68, and CD169, and low expression of CD20 and HLA-DR. These cells are likely to be tumour-associated macrophages (TAMs), which are known to be enriched in the tumour microenvironment and can promote tumour progression.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), characterized by high expression of markers like Mac2/Galectin-3, CD68, and CD169, and low expression of markers like CD57, CD14, and CD8. The high expression of CD68 and CD169 suggests an M2-like polarization, potentially contributing to immunosuppression and tissue remodeling within the tumor microenvironment. The presence of CD103 and Pan-Cytokeratin may indicate their association with the tumor stroma. The overall profile is consistent with a macrophage-enriched population involved in supporting tumor growth and progression.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of Mac2/Galectin-3, CD68, and S100b, and low expression of CD8 and Granzyme B. This cluster may represent a pro-tumorigenic macrophage population that supports tumor growth and suppresses anti-tumor immune responses.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophage Subpopulation
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), characterized by high expression of markers like CD68, Mac2/Galectin-3, and CD169, and low expression of markers like CD14, CD8, and Granzyme B. The high Ki67 and b-Catenin1 expression suggests a proliferative and potentially activated state, consistent with their role in tumor progression and immune suppression. The presence of CD1a and CD103 may indicate a M2-like phenotype, associated with tumor-promoting functions. This population could be involved in angiogenesis, immune modulation, and tissue remodeling within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: Macrophage-enriched cluster with high Ki67, Mac2/Galectin-3, b-Catenin1, CD1a, and CD103 expression, and low CD14, CD8, Granzyme B, Clec9a, mast cell tryptase, and GP100 expression. Markers suggest a mixed population of activated and proliferating macrophages and dendritic cells.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages
MedGemma.description: Likely tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) characterized by high expression of markers like CD68, CD1a, and CD14, and low expression of markers like CD31, CD45RO, and CD169. The presence of CD66 and mast cell tryptase suggests a potential role in inflammation and tissue remodeling. The high expression of Pan-Cytokeratin and CD103 may indicate an epithelial-like phenotype. Overall, this cluster is consistent with a macrophage-enriched population within the tumor microenvironment, potentially contributing to immunosuppression and tumor progression.

BioMistral.title: Activated T cells
BioMistral.description: A cluster of activated T cells with high expression of CD8, CD4, and ICOS, and low expression of CD45RO. These cells are likely to be cytotoxic T cells (CTLs) or helper T cells (Th) that are actively involved in anti-tumour immune responses.

MedGemma.title: Activated Cytotoxic T Cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents activated cytotoxic T cells, consistent with the high expression of CD8, IFNG, and CD57. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pan-Cytokeratin, SOX10) and markers associated with other cell types (CD20, CD4, CD14, CD169) suggests a non-epithelial origin. The presence of CD21 and CD11c could indicate T cell subsets involved in antigen presentation or interaction with other immune cells. The expression of PD-1 and Granzyme B suggests potential exhaustion or activation depending on the context. The presence of CD3e and CD31 could indicate T cell activation and migration.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD68, CD169, and mast cell tryptase, and low expression of CD45RO and CD14. The cluster also exhibits moderate expression of CD31, CD3e, CD103, and CD1c. The spatial distribution of this cluster is consistent with a macrophage-rich niche, which may contribute to immunosuppressive signalling and tissue remodelling.

MedGemma.title: TAMs with Activated Phenotype
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) exhibiting an activated phenotype. The high expression of markers like Mac2/Galectin-3, CD68, and CD14, coupled with low expression of HLA-DR, CD4, and IDO1, is consistent with an activated state. The presence of CD66 suggests a potential role in inflammation. The elevated expression of CD103 and Pan-Cytokeratin may indicate their interaction with the tumor microenvironment. Overall, this cluster is suggestive of a TAM population contributing to tumor progression and immune suppression.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of Mac2/Galectin-3 and CD68, and low expression of CD4 and HLA-DR. This cluster may represent a pro-tumorigenic macrophage population that contributes to tissue remodeling and immunosuppression.

MedGemma.title: activated cytotoxic T cells or NK cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of activated cytotoxic T cells or NK cells, potentially involved in anti-tumor immunity. The high expression of Granzyme B, CD14, HLA-DR, IDO1, and CD11c suggests a role in tumor cell killing and/or immune modulation. The presence of CD4 may indicate a helper T cell subset, potentially involved in coordinating the immune response. The low expression of CD103, Ki67, b-Catenin1, Pan-Cytokeratin, and SOX10 is consistent with a non-epithelial or less proliferative cell type. The overall profile is suggestive of an immune-related cell population within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD14, HLA-DR, and Granzyme B, and low expression of CD103 and Ki67. This cluster may represent a mix of pro- and anti-tumour macrophages, with potential for immunosuppressive signalling.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich stromal niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of the tumor microenvironment characterized by a high density of immune cells, including CD45RO+ T cells, CD14+ monocytes/macrophages, and possibly some CD8+ cytotoxic T cells. The presence of CD103 and CD169 suggests a potential role in immune regulation and tissue remodeling. The high expression of CD1a and GP100 could indicate the presence of dendritic cells or other antigen-presenting cells. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pan-Cytokeratin, b-Catenin1, SOX10) is consistent with a non-epithelial cell population. The overall profile is suggestive of an immune-rich niche with potential roles in modulating the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Activated CD8+ T cells
BioMistral.description: High expression of CD8, CD4, and Ki67, along with low expression of CD14 and IL-33, suggests an activated CD8+ T cell population. This cluster is likely enriched for cytotoxic T cells, which are known to be activated in response to tumour antigens. The presence of CD66, a marker of neutrophils, may indicate an inflammatory microenvironment.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich stromal niche
MedGemma.description: Likely a stromal niche with a high proportion of immune cells, including macrophages (CD68, CD14, CD169), and possibly some dendritic cells (CD1a, CD1c). The presence of CD103 and Axl suggests a role in extracellular matrix remodeling and cell-cell interactions. The low expression of markers like CD31, CD3e, and CD45RO is consistent with a less activated immune cell population. The high expression of CD169 and Axl suggests a role in immune cell recruitment and activation. The presence of CD40 and CD45RO suggests the presence of T cells. The overall profile is suggestive of a niche that supports immune cell function and tissue remodeling.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD169, Axl, and b-Catenin1, and low expression of CD11c, IDO1, and SMA. This cluster may represent a pro-tumorigenic macrophage subtype that contributes to tissue remodeling and immunosuppression.

MedGemma.title: Ki67-High Proliferating Epithelial-Like Cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster exhibits high expression of Ki67, a marker of cell proliferation, and epithelial markers like Pan-Cytokeratin and b-Catenin1. The presence of CD103 and NGFR suggests a potential role in epithelial-mesenchymal transition (EMT) or stem cell maintenance. The low expression of CD8 and Granzyme B, along with the absence of strong cytotoxic markers, is consistent with a non-tumorigenic or less aggressive epithelial cell population. The overall profile is suggestive of a proliferating epithelial-like cell population, possibly involved in tissue repair or regeneration within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: Macrophage-enriched cluster with high Ki67, Mac2/Galectin-3, b-Catenin1, CD103, CD1a, and NGFR expression, and low CD8, mast cell tryptase, GP100, Granzyme B, CD57, Clec9a, Axl, and mast cell tryptase expression. High expression of SMA, CD4, Ki67, AQP1, ICOS, Mac2/Galectin-3, CD31, CD68, b-Catenin1, CD3e, CD103, Pan-Cytokeratin, FOXP3, CD45RO, SOX10, TCF-1, CD14, IL-33, PD-1, Granzyme B, S100b, PD-L1, CD57, CSPG4, Collagen IV, IFNG, IDO1, CD21, CD11c, TOX, CD40, CD1c, NGFR, and Clec9a. Low expression of DAPI, CD20, HLA-DR, Podoplanin, SMA, CD4, Ki67, AQP1, ICOS, Mac2/Galectin-3, CD31, CD68, b-Catenin1, CD3e, CD103, Pan-Cytokeratin, FOXP3, CD45RO, SOX10, TCF-1, CD14, IL-33, PD-1, Granzyme B, S100b, PD-L1, CD57, CSPG4, Collagen IV, IFNG, IDO1, CD21, CD11c, TOX, CD40, CD1c, NGFR, and Clec9a. Size: 1.2% of total cells.

MedGemma.title: Activated Cytotoxic T Cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents activated cytotoxic T cells, consistent with the high expression of Granzyme B, CD8, and CD103. The presence of CD3e and CD45RO suggests a mature T cell population. The low expression of CD20 and FOXP3 is consistent with a cytotoxic T cell phenotype. The elevated expression of CD14 and CD11c may indicate co-localization with antigen-presenting cells or other immune cells. The overall profile suggests an immune response, potentially targeting tumor cells.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD14, HLA-DR, and CD68, and low expression of b-Catenin1, CD31, and CD103. This cluster may represent a pro-tumorigenic macrophage population that contributes to tissue remodeling and immunosuppression.

MedGemma.title: CD8+IFNG+FOXP3+ T cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of CD8+ T cells, characterized by high expression of CD8, IFNG, and FOXP3. The low expression of markers like CD20, CD103, and SOX10, along with the presence of CD57 and Granzyme B, suggests a potential role in cytotoxic activity and/or regulatory T cell function. The presence of CD45RO and CD45RO further supports the presence of memory T cells. The overall profile is consistent with a CD8+ T cell population, possibly with a regulatory or cytotoxic component, and potentially involved in immune surveillance or suppression within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Tumour-associated macrophages
BioMistral.description: A cluster of cells with high expression of CD8, IFNG, CD57, Clec9a, Podoplanin, and FOXP3, and low expression of mast cell tryptase, GP100, Pan-Cytokeratin, SOX10, Mac2/Galectin-3, and b-Catenin1. These cells are likely to be tumour-associated macrophages (TAMs) that are enriched in the stromal compartment and may contribute to immunosuppressive signalling and tissue remodelling.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), characterized by high expression of markers like CD68, CD169, and Mac2/Galectin-3. The low expression of CD8, Granzyme B, and CD57 suggests a non-inflammatory or alternatively activated (M2-like) phenotype. The presence of CD103 and Pan-Cytokeratin further supports the association with the tumor microenvironment. The overall profile is consistent with a role in tumor progression and immunosuppression.

BioMistral.title: Epithelial-like cells
BioMistral.description: Epithelial-like cells are characterized by high expression of Pan-Cytokeratin, SOX10, b-Catenin1, CD103, IL-33, and CD169. They are also enriched for markers of proliferation (Ki67) and immune activation (TCF-1, CD45RO, and PD-1). These cells may represent a subpopulation of tumor cells with an epithelial phenotype or a stromal cell type with an epithelial-like signature.

MedGemma.title: GP100-expressing cells with mast cell tryptase
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of cells expressing GP100 and mast cell tryptase. The high expression of GP100, a marker for Schwann cells and other cell types, combined with mast cell tryptase, suggests a possible role in tissue remodeling or immune modulation. The low expression of CD20, CD103, CD45RO, and SOX10 is consistent with a non-lymphoid cell population. The presence of CD14 and IDO1 may indicate an immune-related function, potentially related to immune suppression or modulation. The overall profile is suggestive of a cell type involved in tissue repair or immune regulation, possibly within the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Immune-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster of immune cells with high expression of mast cell tryptase, PNAd, Granzyme B, CD14, and IDO1, and low expression of CD20, IL-33, Pan-Cytokeratin, CD103, and CD45RO. The cluster is likely enriched for activated cytotoxic T cells, macrophages, and myeloid cells, and may represent an immune-enriched region in the tumour microenvironment.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs), characterized by high expression of markers like CD68, CD169, and CD1a, and low expression of markers like CD11c, CD40, and CD21. The presence of CD66 and CD1c suggests a potential role in tumor progression and immune suppression. The high expression of CD68 and CD169 is consistent with their role in phagocytosis and antigen presentation. The low expression of CD11c and CD40 is suggestive of a less activated or polarized macrophage phenotype. The overall profile is consistent with a TAM population that may be involved in tumor-promoting activities.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD66, SOX10, Pan-Cytokeratin, and b-Catenin1, and low expression of CD11c, Axl, IDO1, Collagen IV, CD40, and NGFR. This cluster is likely to be associated with tissue remodelling and immunosuppressive signalling.

MedGemma.title: Stromal-like Endothelial Cell Cluster
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of endothelial cells, possibly within the tumor microenvironment. The high expression of CD31, AQP1, SMA, and Podoplanin, along with low expression of CD8, Granzyme B, and CD103, is consistent with a phenotype associated with endothelial cells. The presence of CD68 and CD14 suggests potential interactions with myeloid cells. The overall profile is suggestive of a stromal-like endothelial cell population, possibly contributing to tumor angiogenesis and support.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD68, CD14, and CD169, and low expression of CD8 and Granzyme B. The cluster also exhibits high expression of S100b, which is consistent with a macrophage-like phenotype.

BioMistral.title: Immune-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster of immune cells with high expression of PNAd, GP100, CD8, mast cell tryptase, IFNG, and Granzyme B, and low expression of CD66, Axl, CD169, IL-33, CD1c, and CD45RO. The cluster is likely enriched for cytotoxic T cells, macrophages, and mast cells, and may represent an immune-enriched region of the tumour microenvironment.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich stromal niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of the tumor microenvironment characterized by an abundance of immune cells, particularly macrophages and dendritic cells. The high expression of CD68, CD14, CD169, CD1a, and CD66, along with markers like CD11c and ICOS, suggests a role in antigen presentation and immune activation. The presence of CD31 and Podoplanin may indicate interactions with endothelial cells and blood vessels. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pan-Cytokeratin, SOX10) and markers associated with immune suppression (HLA-DR, PD-L1) is consistent with an immune-rich environment. The elevated Ki67 suggests active cell proliferation, potentially indicating ongoing immune responses or tumor cell interactions. The presence of CD45RO and CD4 may indicate the presence of memory T cells. The overall profile is suggestive of an immune-rich stromal niche that may be actively involved in modulating the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD68 and CD169, and low expression of CD103 and CD45RO. The cluster also exhibits high expression of Axl and mast cell tryptase, suggesting a potential role in tissue remodelling and immune regulation.

MedGemma.title: Granzyme B/CD14-rich Immune Infiltrate
MedGemma.description: This cluster exhibits high expression of Granzyme B and CD14, suggesting a cytotoxic T cell or macrophage-like population. The low expression of epithelial markers (Pan-Cytokeratin, b-Catenin1, SOX10) and markers associated with stemness (NGFR) is consistent with a non-epithelial cell type. The presence of CD8 and CD68 further supports the involvement of cytotoxic cells or macrophages. The high expression of CD1c and CD14 may indicate a myeloid cell population, potentially a dendritic cell or macrophage. The overall profile is suggestive of an immune-rich area with cytotoxic activity and/or macrophage presence, possibly involved in tumor cell killing or immune modulation.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD14, Granzyme B, and SMA, and low expression of CD103, PNAd, and b-Catenin1. The cluster is also positive for CD68, Collagen IV, and IFNG, and negative for CD31, CD45RO, and SOX10. The cells in this cluster are likely to be macrophages with an activated phenotype, possibly associated with tissue remodelling.

MedGemma.title: Stromal-Like Cells
MedGemma.description: Likely represents a stromal cell population, characterized by high expression of collagen IV, SMA, and CD31. Low expression of epithelial markers (Pan-Cytokeratin, b-Catenin1, SOX10) and immune markers (CD3, CD20, HLA-DR) suggests a non-epithelial origin. The presence of CD1c and CD68 may indicate macrophages or other myeloid cells within the stromal niche. The expression of AQP1 and Podoplanin could be indicative of pericytes or endothelial cells within the stromal environment. Overall, this cluster is consistent with a stromal cell population contributing to the tumor microenvironment.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD68 and SMA, and low expression of CD103 and Pan-Cytokeratin. The cluster also exhibits high expression of markers associated with immune activation, such as HLA-DR, CD4, and Ki67. The spatial distribution of this cluster suggests a potential role in tissue remodelling and immune regulation.

MedGemma.title: Epithelial-like Cancer Cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents epithelial-like cancer cells, consistent with the high expression of Pan-Cytokeratin, b-Catenin1, and SOX10. The presence of CD103 and CD3e further supports this interpretation. The low expression of immune markers like CD14, CD8, and Granzyme B suggests a reduced immune cell infiltrate and a potentially more autonomous phenotype. The elevated Ki67 expression indicates active proliferation. The overall profile is suggestive of a well-differentiated, proliferative epithelial component within the tumor.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of Mac2/Galectin-3 and CD68, and low expression of CD8 and CD57. This cluster may reflect a pro-tumorigenic or immunosuppressive phenotype, given the association of macrophages with poor prognosis in this cancer type.

BioMistral.title: Activated T cells
BioMistral.description: High expression of CD8, Ki67, and ICOS, consistent with activated T cells. Low expression of CD45RO and FOXP3 suggests a non-regulatory phenotype.

MedGemma.title: TAMs with Epithelial Differentiation
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) exhibiting features of epithelial differentiation. The high expression of Pan-Cytokeratin, b-Catenin1, and SOX10, coupled with low expression of CD68 and CD14, suggests a shift towards an epithelial-like phenotype. The presence of Mac2/Galectin-3 and Axl further supports this, as these markers are often associated with TAMs and their interactions with the tumor microenvironment. The relatively low expression of CD68 and CD14, typical of macrophages, is consistent with this epithelial-like TAM subtype. The presence of CD103, a marker of M2-like macrophages, also supports this interpretation. Overall, this cluster is suggestive of TAMs with a more epithelial-like character, potentially contributing to tumor progression and immune suppression.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of Mac2/Galectin-3 and CD68, and low expression of CD11c and S100b. This cluster may represent a subpopulation of macrophages with an activated phenotype, as suggested by high expression of Axl and low expression of CD169.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich, activated cytotoxic T cells
MedGemma.description: Likely represents activated cytotoxic T cells, consistent with high CD8 and Granzyme B expression. The presence of CD3e and PD-1 suggests potential exhaustion, but the overall profile is suggestive of an active cytotoxic response. The low expression of CD20 and CD45RO is consistent with a T cell population, while the absence of CD14 and CD11c is less typical of myeloid cells. The high Ki67 expression indicates proliferation. The presence of IFNG and IDO1 may indicate a shift towards a more suppressive or exhausted state, but the high CD8 and Granzyme B expression suggests an active cytotoxic response. The low expression of CD1c and CD1a is less typical of dendritic cells. The high expression of CD66 is suggestive of a myeloid cell population.

BioMistral.title: Activated CD8+ T cells
BioMistral.description: Highly activated CD8+ T cells with strong expression of CD103, CD45RO, and Granzyme B, and low expression of CD20 and CD1c. These cells are likely to be cytotoxic T cells that have been activated in response to antigen presentation by dendritic cells or macrophages. They may be involved in anti-tumour responses and are often found in close proximity to tumour cells.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich stromal niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of the tumor microenvironment characterized by a high density of immune cells, including macrophages, dendritic cells, and potentially T cells. The elevated expression of CD1a, Axl, CD169, and PD-L1, along with the low expression of CD57, CD8, and GP100, is suggestive of an immune-rich niche with potential for immune suppression. The presence of CD45RO and PD-1 may indicate activated or exhausted T cells. The high expression of CD68 and CD14 could indicate macrophages and/or myeloid cells. The overall profile is consistent with a region of the tumor microenvironment that may be involved in immune regulation and tumor control.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophage markers, including CD1a, Axl, CD169, and CD45RO, with low expression of T cell markers such as CD8 and CD3e. MedGemma.title: Immune-rich stromal cells
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of immune-rich stromal cells, possibly including macrophages, dendritic cells, or other antigen-presenting cells. The high expression of CD68, CD14, HLA-DR, and CD1a, along with markers like CD1c and CD169, is suggestive of an activated or specialized stromal cell population. The presence of CD40 and CD1c may indicate interactions with T cells. The low expression of markers like CD66 and GP100 is consistent with a non-hematopoietic cell type. The high expression of PD-L1 and PD-1 may indicate immune regulation or exhaustion. The presence of CD31 and CD3e suggests possible interactions with endothelial cells or T cells. The high Ki67 expression may indicate proliferation. Overall, this cluster is likely a component of the tumor microenvironment, potentially contributing to immune modulation or tumor progression.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD68, CD169, and CD1a, and low expression of mast cell tryptase and GP100. This cluster may represent a macrophage-rich niche associated with immunosuppressive signalling and tissue remodelling.

MedGemma.title: Tumor-Associated Macrophages
MedGemma.description: Likely tumor-associated macrophages (TAMs) characterized by high expression of CD68 and CD169, and low expression of CD20 and CD45RO. Consistent with a M2-like phenotype, potentially involved in immunosuppression and tissue remodeling. The presence of CD1a and GP100 suggests a possible association with tumor-associated macrophages, although further context is needed to confirm this. The high expression of CD66 may also be indicative of macrophages.

BioMistral.title: Immune-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster of immune cells with high expression of CD8, CD45RO, and Ki67, and low expression of CD20 and S100b. The cluster is also characterized by high expression of markers associated with cytotoxic T cells (GP100, mast cell tryptase, and granzyme B), macrophages (macrophage-enriched), and lymphoid cells (CD8, CD45RO, and PNAd). The cluster is likely enriched for activated immune cells.

MedGemma.title: Immune-rich stromal niche
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a region of the tumor microenvironment characterized by a high density of immune cells, including macrophages (CD68, CD14), dendritic cells (CD11c, CD1c), and possibly T cells (CD45RO, CD3e, CD4). The presence of markers like CD169, CD1a, and Axl suggests an immune-rich niche with potential for antigen presentation and immune modulation. The low expression of markers like CD8, Granzyme B, and PD-1 is consistent with a suppressive or regulatory role, potentially reflecting an immune-excluded or immune-tolerant environment. The high expression of CD40 and CD1c may indicate interactions with antigen-presenting cells or other immune cells. The presence of CD66 suggests a potential role in immune cell trafficking or activation. Overall, this cluster is suggestive of an immune-rich stromal niche with potential for immune modulation and antigen presentation.

BioMistral.title: Macrophage-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster enriched for macrophages, characterized by high expression of CD68, CD169, and Axl, and low expression of mast cell tryptase, CD14, and GP100. The cluster also exhibits moderate expression of CD45RO, CD31, and PD-L1. The cells in this cluster are likely to be involved in tissue remodelling and immune regulation.

MedGemma.title: CD8+ Granzyme B+ HLA-DR+ CD14+ Cluster
MedGemma.description: This cluster likely represents a population of activated cytotoxic T cells, possibly responding to tumor antigens. The high expression of Granzyme B suggests cytotoxic activity, while HLA-DR and CD14 indicate antigen presentation and activation of the innate immune system, respectively. The presence of CD8 further supports the cytotoxic T cell phenotype. The low expression of Pan-Cytokeratin and AQP1 is consistent with a non-epithelial cell type. The overall profile is suggestive of an immune response against the tumor, potentially contributing to tumor control.

BioMistral.title: Immune-enriched
BioMistral.description: A cluster of immune cells with high expression of HLA-DR, Granzyme B, CD14, CD4, CD11c, and IDO1, and low expression of PNAd, Pan-Cytokeratin, AQP1, SOX10, CD66, and CD31. This cluster is likely enriched for activated cytotoxic T cells, macrophages, and dendritic cells.
